# BHSOFT IT SOLUTION

> Enterprise AI Engineering, Autonomous Voice Agents, Full-Stack Next.js Web Development, and Digital Transformation partner based in Jaipur, Rajasthan, India.

BHSOFT IT SOLUTION helps startups, SMEs, clinics, real estate firms, and enterprises deploy production-grade Artificial Intelligence, autonomous calling systems, bespoke SaaS platforms, and high-performance cloud architectures.

## Core Capabilities & Services

- [Custom Software Development](https://bhsoft.solutions/services/custom-software-development): Bespoke cloud, microservices, and enterprise web solutions.
- [AI & Machine Learning Solutions](https://bhsoft.solutions/services/ai-machine-learning): Autonomous voice agents, LLM agents, RAG pipelines, predictive analytics.
- [Web & Mobile Application Development](https://bhsoft.solutions/services/web-mobile-development): Next.js 16, React 19, React Native, high-performance PWAs.
- [Cloud Architecture & DevOps](https://bhsoft.solutions/services/cloud-devops): AWS, Docker, Kubernetes, zero-downtime CI/CD deployment pipelines.
- [UI/UX & Interactive Design](https://bhsoft.solutions/services/ui-ux-design): Modern light-theme human-centric interface design and 3D web experiences.
- [E-Commerce & Digital Transformation](https://bhsoft.solutions/services/ecommerce-digital): Headless commerce, Shopify, ERP integrations, omnichannel scale.

## Featured Case Studies

- [Shubh Voice AI](https://bhsoft.solutions/portfolio): Autonomous Hindi/English voice agent handling 10,000+ daily inbound calls.
- [FashionTXT Generative AI](https://bhsoft.solutions/portfolio): AI virtual try-on and generative fashion catalog engine.
- [SwadHub Smart Dining](https://bhsoft.solutions/portfolio): Real-time multi-branch cloud kitchen ordering platform.
- [Maira Rugs Global](https://bhsoft.solutions/portfolio): Luxury artisan e-commerce scaling handcrafted heritage export.
